Package bg.tu_varna.ks.contracts

Interface Executable

All Known Implementing Classes:
Agenda, Book, BusyDays, Change, Close, Exit, Find, FindSlot, FindSlotWith, Help, Holiday, Merge, Open, Save, SaveAs, Unbook
public interface Executable
Contract for any object that can be executed by the system.

This interface is the foundation of the Command pattern in the project. Each concrete command (for example Book, Save, Find) implements execute() and encapsulates its own arguments and logic. This allows CommandRunner and CommandFactory to work with commands polymorphically, without knowing their concrete type.

      void execute()
      Executes the operation associated with the concrete command.

      Implementations validate their own arguments, optionally inspect the state of the currently opened file and/or the calendar, and emit results or error messages on System.out or System.err.
